nodes.label: Cogpunk Development Skill
nodes.rationale: Operating manual; a task is not done until all applicable directives D0-D5 are checked off with evidence.

nodes.label: tModLoader 1.4.4 Stable Target
nodes.rationale: 1.4.5 / 1.4.5-dev is contributors-only and unstable; do not publish against it.

nodes.label: ExampleMod 1.4.4 Reference
nodes.rationale: Never invent an API; verify hooks against ExampleMod 1.4.4 first. DeepWiki indexes 1.4.5 so must be cross-checked.

nodes.label: terraria.wiki.gg (Vanilla Numbers)
nodes.rationale: Vanilla stats are never taken from memory.

nodes.label: D0 No Crashes
nodes.rationale: Top priority, wins every conflict: if a faster or prettier version is riskier, choose the safe one. Covers crashes and console loops.

nodes.label: Vanilla Entity Limits
nodes.rationale: Verified by decompiling v2026.08.3.0: NewNPC returns dummy 200, NewProjectile overwrites oldest, ai[] index overflow throws, textures not loaded on dedicated server.

nodes.label: D1 Optimization
nodes.rationale: Zero heap allocations in hot paths; visuals client-only; sync only on change.

nodes.label: D2 Co-op Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Server decides NPC/world/random outcomes; owner-only player projectiles; test SP, host+client, dedicated.

nodes.label: D3 Balance
nodes.rationale: Each combat stat anchored to same-tier vanilla item within +/-15% effective DPS; up to +25% only with a written trade-off.

nodes.label: 4% Base Crit Rule
nodes.rationale: User rule 2026-10-23: leave Item.crit = 0 since Generic supplies 4%; summons skip vanilla crit so minions roll CritChance themselves.

nodes.label: Attack-Pattern Fairness
nodes.rationale: Telegraphs >=30/20/12 ticks by tier, dodgeable without wings pre-T5, spread targeting in co-op, hostile=Ember/Steam vs friendly=Brass/Aether for readability.

nodes.label: D4 Pixel Art
nodes.rationale: 1x drawn, 2x nearest-neighbor export, palette-only, top-left light, no semi-transparent pixels; never scale via Item.scale (mixels).

nodes.label: Seamless Blocks Rule
nodes.rationale: Tiles merge into one clump like vanilla ores; outlines only on exposed sides. Rusted Scrap seam ratio dropped 3.25 -> 0.71.

nodes.label: D5 Visual Proof
nodes.rationale: GIF mandatory when anything moves; in-game capture not required; cheapest faithful method (frames or offline simulation with real constants); self-review before reporting.

nodes.label: Core/Content Slice Architecture
nodes.rationale: Chosen 2026-10-20 after comparing Calamity (type-based), Starlight River (Core + type Content) and Spirit Reforged (feature-based); slices must not depend on each other's internals, shared code moves to Core.

nodes.label: SafeSpawn
nodes.rationale: Validates type ids and NaN, refuses instead of overwriting, reserves 100 projectile / 20 NPC slots for vanilla, server-only NPC and item spawns.

nodes.label: SafeLog
nodes.rationale: Each key reported at most 3 times with deferred formatting, preventing console loops.

nodes.label: PacketRegistry
nodes.rationale: Byte packet ids; refuses more than 256 types at load and catches handler exceptions, dropping the packet.

nodes.label: GenPassUtils
nodes.rationale: InsertAfter falls back to appending if the anchor pass is missing; Replace swaps a vanilla pass.

nodes.label: WorldFlagSystem
nodes.rationale: Saves flags by name, never by numeric id, and syncs on WorldData.

nodes.label: Core Templates Bases (CogpunkItem/NPC/Projectile/Tile/Wall/Buff)
nodes.rationale: Missing-texture fallback means missing art never blocks loading.

nodes.label: StateMachineNPC
nodes.rationale: Owns ai[0] state and ai[1] timer, seals AI(), recovers from NaN; ChangeState ignored on clients and syncs only on change.

nodes.label: SceneOverlayRegistry
nodes.rationale: The one reflection touch in Core/Hooks; needed to register fake-liquid overlays since 1.4.4 has no ModLiquid.

nodes.label: Scrappy Trunk Loot
nodes.rationale: Scrappy Trunks replace 20% of Wooden Chests and hold pre-Hardmode non-boss trinkets flagged ScrappyTrunkTrinket.

nodes.label: Vent Keybind
nodes.rationale: World effect is an owner-spawned projectile (synced automatically) rather than a direct NPC hit.

nodes.label: Junkyard Vanilla Region Replacement
nodes.rationale: Junkyard replaces left beach/ocean after Micro Biomes (Calamity Sulphurous Sea slot). Decided 2026-10-22 to keep vanilla big structures out instead of shrinking around them.

nodes.label: Fake Liquid via Overlay
nodes.rationale: 1.4.4 has no ModLiquid and liquid arrays are sized LiquidID.Count = 4, so liquids are non-solid tiles drawn by a vanilla Overlay at RenderLayers.Entities.

nodes.label: 1.4.5 Port Readiness
nodes.rationale: Prefer public hooks; IL edits, detours and reflection are last resort and isolated in Core/Hooks with a comment.
